title: Token Settlement Aggregator for Cross-Environment Metering
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a daily and nearline aggregator that consolidates raw token-metering events from streaming gateways, edge collectors, and batch ingest into a single canonical settlement feed for billing. The job will: normalize token types (prompt/completion/embedding), apply per-route and per-tenant pricing ladders, fold prefix/KV-cache hits into netted token counts, detect and suppress cross-region duplicates using a deterministic fingerprint + idempotency key strategy, validate schema version and emit signed audit line items to the billing ledger. This reduces mismatches between real-time quota counters and final invoices and enables deterministic retroactive adjustments. The scope includes implementation of the aggregator service, schema migrations for the settlement record, end-to-end tests with synthetic duplicate patterns, and dashboarding for reconciliation deltas. Out of scope: UI billing changes and invoice formatting logic (handled by finance pipeline).
acceptance_criteria: Aggregator produces a daily settlement feed with per-tenant line items and metadata (schema v1.0) and a signed hash for auditability.
End-to-end reconciliation delta against canonical test dataset is <= 0.1% for token counts and <= 0.05% for charge amounts across a 7-day synthetic replay.
Duplicate detection correctly suppresses >= 99.99% of injected cross-region duplicate events in test harness; false-suppression rate < 0.001%.
Pipeline supports schema rollover with backwards-compatible consumer mode and automated validation checks before release.
Audit trail retained for 90 days and an operational dashboard surfaces per-route variance, skewed customers, and failing partitions.
Integration tests cover: per-route pricing overrides, prefix/KV-cache credit folding, and idempotency edge cases (out-of-order delivery, late arrival).
